verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SEIU Local 99 will continue to move forward with the strike on April 14 if no agreement is reached'; R3: 'LAUSD strike averted... reached a tentative agreement with the last of three unions'; R4: 'continuing late-night contract negotiations... to avert a looming strike'; R5: 'Agreement in Principle Reached between Los Angeles Unified and SEIU April 14, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe SEIU Local 99 threatening or planning a strike but confirm it was averted via tentative agreement reached early April 14, 2026; no source states they are actively on strike.
